fact: Articles 374 and 375 of the 2015 Penal Code of the State of Eritrea make unauthorized use of a computer an offence (Class 2 petty offence, 1 to 6 months or a fine of 5,001 to 20,000 Nakfas; aggravated against a public or financial institution, 3 to 5 years), though no Gazette date of entry into force was located.
title: Penal Code of the State of Eritrea, Unauthorized Use of a Computer
